text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the dance studio, I happen to
see
Yamanin Zephyr inside by herself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hah! Hup!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hm... It still doesn't feel right...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer... And yet, the turbulent
winds in my
heart won't calm down.
choice_data_list: I don't think it was a bad dance at all, though.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
As one accustomed to melodies carried
by the
wind and the swaying of the
trees, the music and
dances of people
feel... strange.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No matter how the wind blows, the lyrics
and
choreography of this song remain
unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even if the melody creates discord with
the winds
of the moment, the
performance must go on,
against
nature...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It's... difficult for me, if not quite as bad
as a
frosty gale in summer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being the free spirit that she is,
conforming to a
set dance routine may
feel uncomfortable. But
there's no
opting out of a class assignment...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...The headwind?
choice_data_list: Sometimes you've got to ride into the headwind, too.
Why not invite a breeze that matches the song?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That is... very true.
choice_data_list: Unfavorable winds are bound to blow sometimes.
Unfavorable winds are bound to blow sometimes, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Nature is unpredictable. Sometimes, just
when
you think a benison breeze is
blowing your way,
you're confronted
with a storm.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a headwind is simply another kind
of
wind—which means I must adapt and
learn to ride
it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Read the wind and adapt... Yes, that

encapsulates what living amidst nature is
about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Convinced by her own reflections on the
topic,
Yamanin Zephyr resumes her
practice with quiet
determination.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by "summon"?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her talk about the winds just now may
be
referring to her own feelings or the
mood of the
place. If that's the case,
getting someone else
involved might
help.
choice_data_list: Let's do it with someone who carries a breeze that suits the song.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I see... Well, if I'm looking for someone to help with this song, then...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'd like you to perform with me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
In the past, I've felt a fair wind blowing
my way
while in your company.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There's no rule that says you can't. Join
me, and
let's summon the wind together.
choice_data_list: Still, I can't sit in on your proficiency test, you know?
But I can't sit in on the assignment test, you know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Yamanin Zephyr and I
sing and
dance together as her teacher
watches on with a
forced smile.
